data.body:
*Last updated: 12 November 2026 · By the NM7 Team*

> **Quick answer:** NM7 (nm7.si) is an Indian hiring and career platform that calls itself "Blinkit for hiring". Job seekers and students build an ATS-safe resume free (from photos, their own words or an old file), find fresher jobs from checked companies and apply. Colleges and job fairs run whole resume drives on it. Verified companies post jobs free and see ranked applicants. Building a resume, the ATS scan, the job board, the match score and Manual Apply are free. Expert rewrites, Auto Apply and add-on packs are paid.

## What is NM7?

NM7 is a platform at **nm7.si** that sits on both sides of hiring in India. On one side are job seekers, freshers and students who need a resume recruiters can read and a list of real jobs to apply to. On the other side are companies that want to hire freshers and early-career people quickly, and colleges, job fairs and NGOs that run placement drives.

The idea behind the name "Blinkit for hiring" is speed. Blinkit made groceries arrive in minutes. NM7 wants hiring to work the same way: a company posts a role, NM7 ranks the people who fit, and the company can move from job post to shortlist in about 30 minutes, without wading through hundreds of unreadable resumes.

NM7 is made by AsuraaX AI Private Limited. Its free career guides for job seekers are on the [NM7 blog](https://nm7.si/blog).

## What can you do on NM7?

What you can do depends on who you are.

| You are | What NM7 gives you | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Job seeker or student | Resume builder, ATS-safe templates, free ATS scan, job board with a match score, Manual Apply | Free (free account needed to download) |
| Job seeker who wants help | Expert rewrite by a verified professional, LinkedIn pack, Tailor pack, Interview pack, Auto Apply | Paid, see [Pricing](https://nm7.si/pricing) |
| College, job fair or NGO | Resume drives: invite links, approvals, reminders, event kiosks, printing in your own template, recruiter links, GST invoices | Free plan, paid plans for bigger drives |
| Company or recruiter | Post jobs, see ranked applicants, verified-company badge | Free for verified companies |

### Build a resume from what you already have

You do not need to start from a blank page. The [resume builder](https://nm7.si/builder) opens from wherever you are:

- **I have a resume:** upload a PDF or Word file and NM7 sorts it into clean sections.
- **I have papers:** take photos of certificates or a handwritten note and NM7 fills in the details.
- **I have nothing:** answer simple questions, one section at a time.
- **I have a LinkedIn:** upload your LinkedIn profile PDF and NM7 fills every section it can.

You can also speak or type your details in Telugu, Hindi or any of 8 Indian languages, and the summary writer turns them into a clear English summary. Every template is ATS-safe, so applicant tracking systems can read it.

### Check your resume for free

The [free ATS scan](https://nm7.si/scan) gives your resume a score and tells you what to fix. It needs no sign-up.

### Find and apply for jobs

The [NM7 job board](https://nm7.si/jobs) lists internships, fresher jobs and roles for 0–3 years of experience. Each job shows your match score, so you can see how well your resume fits before you apply. Searching, saving and Manual Apply are free. If you want NM7 to do the applying, Auto Apply lets you choose the jobs you want; NM7 applies each morning and asks you before anything unusual.

### Run a resume drive

Colleges, job fairs and NGOs share one join link or QR code. Students join with their own free account, build their resume, and the coordinator approves, sends reminders and prints the whole batch in the college's own template, or shares a shortlist link with recruiters. Kiosk mode lets people build and print resumes at an event. The Free plan covers one group of up to 50 members and one coordinator. Details are on the [For organizations](https://nm7.si/for-orgs) page.

### Hire on NM7

Companies sign up in five steps on the [For companies](https://nm7.si/for-companies) page. NM7 checks every company before its jobs reach students: the company email must be on the company's own website domain, and the registration number (GSTIN, CIN or LLPIN) is checked on the government site. Verified companies post jobs free, see ranked applicants and get a verified badge on their listings.

## Who is NM7 for?

- **Freshers and students** who need a first resume and want to apply to real entry-level jobs.
- **Early-career job seekers** (0–3 years) who want a resume that passes ATS screening and a faster way to apply.
- **People who are not comfortable with long forms or English.** The easy dashboard uses big buttons and plain words, and you can give your details in your own language.
- **Colleges, training institutes, job fairs and NGOs** that run placement or resume drives.
- **Companies and recruiters** hiring freshers, interns and early-career talent.

## How is NM7 different from a regular job portal?

Most job portals in India are a search box and a list of jobs. NM7 joins three things that are usually separate:

1. **The resume.** NM7 helps you make the resume first, in a format ATS software can read, instead of assuming you already have one.
2. **The match.** Every job shows how well your resume fits it, so you spend your time on jobs you have a real chance at.
3. **The employer check.** Companies are checked before their jobs go live, which cuts down on fake listings and fee-asking "recruiters".

For companies the difference is speed. Instead of a pile of mixed-quality resumes, recruiters see applicants ranked against the role.

## Is my data safe on NM7?

Your resume is seen only by you and, if you order one, your assigned expert. If you use a photo of your Aadhaar or another ID card to fill in your name or address, the ID number itself is removed and never saved or printed. You can download or delete all your data from Settings. In a resume drive, your college sees your resume only because you join its group and share it.

## Who runs NM7?

NM7 is built and run by AsuraaX AI Private Limited, founded by Naresh Maddela. You can reach the team through the [contact page](https://nm7.si/contact).

## FAQ

### What is NM7?

NM7 (nm7.si) is an Indian hiring and career platform. Job seekers build ATS-safe resumes free and apply to fresher jobs from checked companies; colleges run resume drives; verified companies post jobs free and see ranked applicants.

### Is NM7 free?

Yes, to start. Building a resume, all templates, the ATS scan, the job board, your match score and Manual Apply are free. A free account is needed to download. Expert rewrites, Auto Apply and add-on packs are paid.

### Why is NM7 called "Blinkit for hiring"?

Because the goal is speed: a company posts a role, NM7 ranks the people who fit, and the company can get from job post to shortlist in about 30 minutes.

### Can I use NM7 in Telugu or Hindi?

Yes. You can speak or type your details in Telugu, Hindi or any of 8 Indian languages, and NM7 writes a clear English summary for your resume.

### Can companies post jobs on NM7?

Yes. Companies sign up in five steps and NM7 checks the company email domain and registration number before their jobs go live. Posting is free for verified companies.

### Who owns NM7?

NM7 is run by AsuraaX AI Private Limited, founded by Naresh Maddela.

## Final thoughts

If you need a resume, start with the free builder and the ATS scan, then use your match score on the job board to decide where to apply. If you hire freshers or run placement drives, NM7 is built to get you from "we need people" to a shortlist fast.
